shortDescription: Dungeons from Alexander Wales' "This Used to Be About Dungeons": levelled sites across the world map that generate a fresh themed pocket map per party, stocked with Titan Framework creatures and Entad Framework rewards.
body:
## Status
Build order: 1 World → 2 Entry → 3 Map generation → 4 Creatures → 5 Rewards → 6 Vehicle Framework.
Phase 1 done and tested (summary commit 35fdd06, builds 1-8). Phase 2 in testing (builds 9-15). Run #53 found a carried horse destroyed at the exit (fixed in build 13). Build 14 added the caravan stats strip and the wall stairway exit.

## World (phase 1)
- `DungeonWorldComponent`: dungeons as plain data (surface tile id + level), saved as byte arrays, with `genVersion`, `generatedMaxLevel`. `enteredBy`: per tile, load ids of pawns who entered (`HasEntered`/`MarkEntered`), cleared by Generate.
- Placement: seeded random order, BFS-blocked radius spacing-1. Land only unless Vehicle Framework + ocean setting.
- Levels: 3-octave Perlin over the unit sphere, ranked, level = 1 + floor(p^skew × max).
- Blocked = a MapParent other than our own DungeonSite on the tile.
- `WorldDrawLayer_Dungeons`: one batched mesh, custom UVs so the sprite points north, tint by level.
- Bottom-right toggles: show/hide icons, open dungeon finder. Tile inspect "Dungeon: level N". Vanilla world search lists "Dungeon (level N)".
- `Dialog_DungeonFinder`: party checklist (load caravan, untick retainers), level range, distance from colony/caravan, results with highlight rings (World/TUBAD_Highlight).

## Entry (phase 2)
- Ways in: "Enter dungeon (level N)" caravan gizmo on a dungeon tile (disabled while moving or a party is inside); right-click a dungeon tile with a caravan selected (postfixes on both FloatMenuMakerWorld.ChoicesAtFor overloads; travels there with CaravanArrivalAction_EnterDungeon, then opens the dialog); a caravan formed with a dungeon as destination does the same.
- `Dialog_EnterDungeon`: vanilla split-caravan layout (pawns / items / travel supplies). Vanilla caravan stats strip (mass, speed, days of food, forage, visibility): caravan left outside vs party going in; party only when everyone goes in (then unticked pawns are counted too). Below it: people n / cap (humanlikes only), party wealth, effective level with tooltip. Rules: at least one non-downed colonist; humanlikes ≤ cap; nobody who has entered this dungeon. If nobody able stays outside, every pawn goes in and unticked items wait in the site's stash.
- Party wealth = market value of the pawns going in + worn apparel + equipment (not inventory). Effective level = level × (1 + wealth / wealthToDouble), stored on the site for phases 4-5.
- `DungeonEntry.Enter`: long event; makes a `DungeonSite` (MapParent) on the tile, generates a 100×100 map, splits the caravan the vanilla way, marks humanlikes as entered, enters in front of the exit, letter.
- One instance per dungeon. DungeonSite disables vanilla generic Enter, transport pods and shuttles. A mapless leftover site is destroyed by CanEnterAt.

## Inside and leaving (phase 2)
- Placeholder map (`GenStep_DungeonPlaceholder`, replaced in phase 3): concrete floor, thick rock roof, a chain of rooms joined by 3-wide corridors cut out of TUBAD_DungeonWall. Fog revealed from the cell in front of the exit.
- TUBAD_DungeonWall: rock-atlas look, no hit points, not destroyable, mineable, deconstructible or targetable.
- `DungeonExit` (MapPortal subclass): a 3×1 stairway set into the middle of the first room's north wall (impassable, holds roof, own placeholder texture Things/Building/TUBAD_DungeonExit). Pawns use it by touch from the room. "Leave dungeon..." opens `Dialog_LeaveDungeon` (vanilla Dialog_EnterPortal listing every reachable item). Chosen pawns fetch chosen items, haul them in, and walk through. Pawns are moved out next tick (join the caravan on the tile, or form one); carried items go to inventory first; hauled things go to the site stash and then the caravan. Hauled pawns (downed or roped animals, downed people) join the caravan as members.
- Map removed when no living player humanlike or mech is spawned (downed counts as alive; corpses and animals don't). Site destroyed with it. A colonist left in the stash with no caravan outside forms one. "Party lost" letter when nobody came out.

## Settings (tabs)
- World: show icons, opacity 40%, tint by level, spacing 10, max level 30, low level bias 1.5, roughness 7, ocean dungeons with VF.
- Parties: max party size 5 (people only), wealth that doubles the level 50,000 (5k-300k).
- Planned: Creatures, Rewards.

## Agreed design (later phases)
- Map generation themed from surroundings, chambers divided by doors/rubble/vines; unbreakable outer walls with a normal inner layer possible.
- Creatures via Titan: humanlikes, animals, insects, mechs if feasible; points from effective level; packs; Dungeon Madness rules; tamable; suspended in undiscovered rooms.
- Rewards via EntadApi; binding single / party / unbound by settings.

## Textures
- World/TUBAD_Dungeon, World/TUBAD_Highlight, UI/TUBAD_ShowDungeons, UI/TUBAD_FindDungeons, Things/Building/TUBAD_DungeonExit (placeholder SVG). Enter gizmo uses vanilla EnterCave, leave uses vanilla ExitCave.

## Mockups
- .circinus/mockups/dungeon-finder.html
